types/utils.ts/Overwrite: only overwrite keys of objects

Overwrite<string,string> resulted in a mangled object type
because the existing implementation iterated over the string
type's keys (e.g. 'charCodeAt')

This commit changes the implementation so that keys are only
iterated and overwritten in the case of objects. Otherwise,
a non-never TWith type will entirely replace TType, e.g.
Overwrite<string, number> results in 'number'.

summary.intent: Fix inference of procedure inputs after .use() middleware by making Overwrite replace non-object types instead of key-mapping them (commit 7dc04a7e; the supplied PR body is an unfilled template and adds no intent).
summary.issue_fit: Met - no originating issue exists, so issue alignment was unavailable; the commit message's stated outcomes are implemented and regression-tested.
summary.coverage: Complete merge-base diff of both changed files reviewed with Overwrite's call sites in procedureBuilder.ts and middleware.ts. Reviewer-executed: tsc --noEmit in packages/tests at the head, clean. A scratch type-level check outside the clone confirmed the old Overwrite mangles string but the new one yields string, unions still distribute, and never, undefined and any behave sensibly. The runtime suite was not run; the target is type-only.
